_comment: Street and building geometry around the studio, from OpenStreetMap via Overpass, projected into a 0-1000 square. Regenerate with `npm run map`. Committed so the build never depends on Overpass. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Coordinates are whole units in a 0-1000 square: at render width that is well under a pixel, so the decimals were paying bytes for nothing.
